structure.unit: Offenses Relating to Railroads and Other Utilities

law.catch_line: Diverting wastewater line; diverting or wasting public water supply
law.text: Any person who willfully and maliciously (i) diverts any public wastewater or sewer line or (ii) diverts or wastes any public water supply by tampering with any fire hydrant shall be guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.
